works.title: Intuition Book / The Missing Manual
works.description: A book on making intuition a trainable skill, filling the gap in Gladwell's work on expert intuition. Focuses on pattern saturation, deliberate cultivation of intuitive capability across dominant modalities (visual, verbal, written), and positioning intuition as learnable rather than fixed. Bridges cosmology and quantum mechanics work into a cross-disciplinary ecosystem.
works.quote: I have a later chapter in the book—chapter 25 or something—that goes into my learning process... the book essentially says: become an expert and this might happen to you. It never says: here is the process by which you deliberately cultivate it. What you're describing is the missing manual.
